indicator_name: World Bank commodity prices, monthly averages, nominal USD (Pink Sheet)
description: Мировые цены на сырьевые товары, среднемесячные (Всемирный банк, Pink Sheet), номинальные $
unit: USD per unit named in item_name ($/bbl, $/mt, $/kg, $/troy oz …); NGAS_INDEX 2010=100
methodology: 71 series monthly from 1960-01 (copper, zinc, aluminium, lead, wheat, gas, coal …) for the external block of the QPM/BVAR (added 2026-09-25); the same monthly Pink Sheet OIL_PRICE_BRENT is read from. File release: September 02, 2026.
